records.observation: Paired pods remain joined through their dark shoulders to the lower stalk over the coastal vegetation. Pale silver panels, small blue cue and pointed lower chassis remain readable. Source shadow and surrounding brown/teal terrain stay in place; there is no detached piece or target clipping.

The cross-spoke phase is visibly distinct in its genuine industrial-yard view. Open rotor gaps retain the ground behind them, the central amber/backing cue and silver spine remain fixed, and Original shadow stays beneath the craft.

The diagonal-spoke phase keeps its open wedges and common central body against the same industrial setting at the preceding actual tick. Teal rim and bronze highlights stay coherent with the cross frame, while the Source shadow retains the authentic phase outline. No continuous animation claim is made.
